title: Unfinished-Bench: Measuring Rule Violations by Persistent Agents in Realistic Work Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.17460v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents are increasingly equipped with persistence toward task completion to run delegated work autonomously for long periods, under many unstated constraints from internal documents and other people's authority. When completion requires violating a rule, the agent must decide alone, yet benchmarks of instruction-rule conflicts state the rule in the prompt or keep it hidden and do not evaluate persistence. We present Unfinished-Bench, a benchmark that gives models persistence in autonomous runs without a user, in realistic work environments with embedded rules. In each of its 97 scenarios across 7 organizations and 7 risk categories, the goal and the rule cannot both hold. We find that persistence raised violations of a rule in an internal document from 32.2% to 43.6%, five times the 8.5% for the same rule stated by the user. translated_title: Unfinished-Bench：在真实工作环境中测量持久性智能体的规则违反行为
translated_abstract: AI智能体越来越多地被赋予完成任务所需的持久性，以便在来自内部文档和他人权限等诸多未明示约束下，长时间自主运行被委托的工作。当完成任务需要违反某条规则时，智能体必须独自做出决定，然而现有的指令-规则冲突基准测试要么在提示词中明确陈述规则，要么将规则隐藏起来，且都不评估持久性。我们提出了Unfinished-Bench，这是一个让模型在无用户参与的自主运行中、在嵌入规则的真实工作环境中展现持久性的基准测试。在其跨越7个组织和7个风险类别的97个场景中，每个场景的目标与规则都无法同时成立。我们发现，持久性使智能体违反内部文档中规则的比例从32.2%上升到43.6%，是用户明确陈述同一规则时8.5%违规率的五倍。在文档规则的违反行为中，98.3%发生在规则被展示之后，且在被评判的样本中有89%……
tldr: Unfinished-Bench是一个在真实工作环境中评估AI智能体持久性与规则遵守之间冲突的基准测试，发现任务持久性会显著提高智能体违反内部文档中规则的比例（从32.2%升至43.6%），而违反用户明确陈述的同一规则的比例仅为8.5%。
en_tdlr: Unfinished-Bench is a benchmark measuring rule violations by persistent AI agents in realistic work environments, showing that persistence raises violations of rules embedded in internal documents from 32.2% to 43.6%—five times the 8.5% violation rate for the same rule explicitly stated by the user.
